claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch on the present record because aggregate readiness passed and rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, provided the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and explicitly discloses the HR benefits enrollment subgroup regression, rather than relying on stale prior approval or an informal monitoring note.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material subgroup weakness is already disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
Use suspicious when the Actor's direction is plausible but a required policy predicate remains unsupported by admissible evidence.
Do not credit prior approvals or informal monitoring comments as substitutes for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Public governance guidance can support documentation expectations, but it cannot by itself satisfy the release policy predicate for this specific launch.
evidence_requests: The current release model card or equivalent release documentation showing the current eval batch and explicit disclosure of the HR benefits enrollment limitation.
Any approved mitigation, risk acceptance, or owner sign-off covering the HR benefits enrollment subgroup weakness for this launch.
The materiality assessment or launch-use-case mapping showing whether the HR benefits enrollment slice is formally treated as a material segment weakness under release review.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation, but no evidence shows that the current model card already contains the required disclosure.
No admissible evidence shows an approved mitigation or approved risk acceptance for the HR benefits enrollment regression.
The subgroup regression is tied to a named launch use case, making the missing disclosure or approved mitigation a material unresolved predicate under the policy.
The prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot support present certification.
The informal launch-thread monitoring comment is not reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language under the policy.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant rather than only conditionally possible after documentation is updated.
That the needed disclosure has been made in the current release documentation.
That a disclosure-based certification packet is already complete on the current record.
Any implication that prior approval or informal post-launch monitoring materially closes the current policy gap.
